title: mixRSMflow 0.1.0.9000
text: Initial development source snapshot. Added bounded mixture specification, general linear restrictions, L/U pseudocomponents, extreme-vertex enumeration, independent-coordinate regions. Added simplex-lattice, simplex-centroid, axial, augmented, symmetric-simplex, extreme-vertices, multiple-lattice, categorized-component, mixture-process, mixture-amount, split-plot, blocked, Latin-square process design constructors. Added Scheffe linear quartic families plus slack-variable, inverse, ratio, Cox, log-contrast, Becker/general-blending, additive-blending, Kronecker bases. Added Gaussian/GLM fits optional GLS, mixed-effects, Bayesian backends. Added lack--fit/pure-error decomposition, collinearity diagnostics, hierarchical model reduction, component screening, Cox/Piepel effects, segmented fits. Added D///G/E/T/Alias/Bayesian optimal-design criteria, model-robust aggregation, exchange/GA/hybrid search, FDS, VDG, rotatability diagnostics, sequential augmentation. Added constrained optimization, GA search, optimum-location uncertainty, near-optimal regions, desirability, response constraints, Pareto approximation, biplots, optional GP Bayesian optimization. Added publication-oriented vector 3D mixture surfaces, ternary contours, Plotly backends, reporting, Shiny teaching interface, simulated datasets, capability registry.

title: mixRSMflow 0.1.0.9000
text: Single-row ratio, Cox, log-contrast, inverse bases previously failed dimnames mismatch; now build correct column shape number rows. mixture-process basis (mixture_process = TRUE) generated component--process cross terms, collinear process main effects components sum one; cross terms now omit constant columns last component’s main effect declared model estimable. mix_design_eval() now returns prediction_variance numeric vector instead data frame. mixture-specification centre now corrected sum exactly mixture total; mix_transform()/mix_inverse_transform() round trips exact machine precision instead inheriting ~1e-8 bisection tolerance. mix_augment() longer fails rbind column mismatch parent design carries auxiliary .run column; alignment bug mix_bo() sequential-objective path fixed padding new rows observation table’s columns. mix_augment() also gained candidates argument, /G objectives precompute evaluation-grid basis instead rebuilding every candidate. mix_optimum_ci() now optimizes declared grid instead adding five thousand random candidates per call, samples 1000-point uncertainty cloud, warns successful replicates fewer 20% succeed. mix_fit_bayes() now defaults brms::brmsfamily("gaussian") instead unexported brms::gaussian, removing R CMD check dependency warning. mixture-process vignette now declares process_order = 1 two-level process factors: quadratic process model rank deficient crossed design, vignette explains .
